name: Khoj
tagline: Self-hosted AI second brain for semantic search across personal docs and web
real_test_summary: Indexed 300 local Markdown and PDF notes on macOS M2 16GB RAM and ran semantic search queries paired with local Llama 3.2 via Ollama.
pros: Native plugins for Obsidian, Emacs, Browser, and Desktop
Works completely offline with local Ollama LLMs
Supports scheduled research automations and custom agents
cons: Docker deployment recommended for full background automation features
Initial embedding indexing uses noticeable CPU on large vaults
description: Open-source personal AI assistant that indexes PDF, Markdown, Word, and Notion notes locally and connects to Ollama models for private RAG answers, scheduled automations, and deep research.
